name: Camarillo Village Square
demographics: Camarillo Village Square serves a predominantly middle to upper-middle class suburban demographic in Ventura County, with visitors typically ranging from young families to retirees aged 30-65. The trade area draws from Camarillo's affluent residential neighborhoods, with median household incomes significantly above the California average, attracting shoppers seeking convenient access to everyday retail and dining options. The center caters to family-oriented consumers who value quality retailers and services in an accessible open-air format, with shopping patterns reflecting both planned weekly trips and spontaneous convenience visits.
description: Camarillo Village Square stands as a prominent community shopping destination in the heart of Camarillo, California, serving the retail needs of Ventura County residents since its establishment. Located at 2350 Las Posas Road, this open-air shopping center has become an integral part of the local community, offering a convenient and accessible shopping experience for families and professionals alike. The center's strategic location in Camarillo, a city known for its pleasant climate and quality of life, makes it a natural gathering place for residents seeking a diverse mix of retail, dining, and service options. With its well-maintained facilities and ample parking, Camarillo Village Square provides a comfortable shopping environment that reflects the community-oriented values of the area. The center's strong reputation, evidenced by its 4.4-star rating from over 835 reviews, demonstrates its continued relevance and appeal to local shoppers who appreciate its blend of national retailers and local businesses in a welcoming outdoor setting.
summary: Camarillo Village Square is a well-established community shopping center located on Las Posas Road in Camarillo, California. This open-air retail destination serves the local community with a convenient mix of shopping, dining, and services, earning strong customer ratings for its accessible location and quality tenant mix.
